jobs.description:
Your team

主にリテール公募投信を担当するプロダクトスペシャリストとして、受託者責任（fiduciary）および説明責任（accountability）を果たしつつ、ビジネスの拡大に貢献していただきます。 資産運用、運用商品および金融市場に関する専門知識を活かし、当社で提供する主にリテール公募投信のデ ューデリジェンス、運用報告、RFP対応、等を担当いただきます。 また、資産クラス横断または一部担当ファンドに関して、顧客向け投資情報に関する資料、投資環境説明用 資料、販売促進用資料、販売用資料等の作成ならびに提供を担当いただきます。

Your role

• 当社で提供する主にリテール公募投信の運用状況の把握、対外説明、運用報告書等のコメント作成

• 当社で提供する主にリテール公募投信の運用戦略、運用モニタリングおよびデューデリジェンス

• RFPや顧客からの質問への対応（RFPチームと協働）

• 社内各種プロジェクトへの参加・貢献

• 顧客向け投資情報に関する資料、投資環境説明用資料、販売促進用資料、販売用資料等の作成ならびに提供

• データチェック及びレポート類のWebサイトへのアップロード作業

• グローバルのピクテ・グループの資料の翻訳、チェック等（生成AI等の活用を想定）

Your profile

• 金融業界（運用会社、証券会社等）における5年超の経験

• 主にリテール公募投信の運用、商品に関連する知識、業務経験

• 英語：ビジネス・レベル、日本語：ネイティブレベル

jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks. By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

This function will join the Quality Control & Mobile team , reporting to the head of the team. In this role you will work on quality-control-related activities for the three teams (FA, TA and PETAL) and occasionally help the production teams during peak periods.

Your role

Mobile team

• Participate mainly for short support missions within the fund operational units to absorb operational overloads, identify process optimizations and support implementation of initiatives supporting operational efficiency.

• Identify areas of improvement in terms of the process and control framework, based on your experience in other teams and departments.

The role of the function is to participate mainly for short support missions within the fund operational units to absorb operational overloads, identify process optimizations and support implementation of initiatives supporting operational efficiency.

Quality Control

• Contribute to the implementation of key quality control deliverables such as KPIs developed with our BI platform (Tableau).

• Coordinate transversal reporting.

• Contribute to any other transversal project aimed at improving service delivery.

Your profile

Education:

• Master’s degree in Business administration or engineering (finance, IT, mathematics).

Requested experience:

• 1 to 3 years’ experience in project management and change management, Process / data modelling, Fund operations or banking sector.

Technical skills:

• Project Management skills.

• Data analysis and office tools skills (Excel, Tableau, PowerPoint, etc.).

Soft skills:

• Organisational skills.

• Diligent in achieving objectives.

• Strong analytical and synthesis skills.

• Effective communication abilities and good interpersonal skills.

• Commitment-oriented mindset and a team spirit.

Language skills:

• Fluent in French and English

Note

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

Flexible and modern ways of working

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave.

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.title: Compliance Officer
jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Pictet has been present in Singapore for more than 30 years where it employs over 200 people.

The Compliance function is responsible for helping Pictet’s senior management manage the compliance risks faced by Pictet. This role will focus on the risks faced by Pictet’s Singapore bank, Banque Pictet & Cie SA (BPSA) Singapore Branch.

The AML/CFT Compliance Officer is part of the team that oversees the Bank’s financial crime framework, focused primarily on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance. The incumbent performs systematic AML/CFT reviews on high-risk clients before onboarding and subsequent periodic reviews, reviews alerts/issues escalated by first-line functions and reports suspicions of criminal or sanctioned activity, and provides advice on AML/CFT and sanctions management. . The officer monitors changes that may impact the business, working with business and support functions to ensure that the Bank complies with regulatory obligations and Group standards in the financial crime area. The role will report to the Compliance AML Lead.

Your role

Key responsibilities

-Investigate relevant alerts and suspicious activities, and perform filing of STR to local authorities.
-Perform ex-ante AML reviews on high-risk client onboarding and periodic reviews.
-Review escalated alerts from first-line transaction monitoring, payment filtering and ongoing name screening controls.
-Support external requests include production orders, due diligence queries and any relevant regulatory reporting (e.g. Remote Gambling Act reporting).
-Act as an expert advisor to business and support functions on compliance and regulatory matters related to AML/CFT and international sanctions management.
-Perform an annual AML/CFT Enterprise-wide Risk Assessment (EWRA) identifying risks and framework/control gaps to the attention of management and Group -Compliance.
-Assist with periodical risk-based design and operating effectiveness testing of first-line AML/CFT controls, including on lower-risk clients.
-Represent Compliance as needed on financial crime related projects and initiatives.
-Assist in the resolution of Compliance-owned management action plans from audits, inspections and Group reviews.
-Produce relevant management information reports to board and senior management on the governance of financial crime risks.
-Build and maintain a proactive and constructive relationship with business and functional stakeholders to ensure appropriate controls are in place for financial crime risk identification and management.
-Keep abreast and understand the impact of new financial crime regulations and where needed, represent the Bank in industry consultations.
-Support the Singapore AML Lead on all AML/CFT matters and any other duties as assigned.

Your profile

-Bachelor Degree in law, banking or business.
-Working knowledge of the CDSA, AML/CFT typologies, relevant MAS Regulations and Guidance on AML/CFT and the international sanctions framework.
-Working experience of Singapore regulatory landscape and expectations needed. Familiarity with regulations and guidance in an AML, Financial crime Compliance role.
-6-10 years of relevant experience in AML/CFT compliance particularly on investigations.
-Prior experience in a similar role in a Private Bank will be advantageous.
-Highly effective verbal and written communication and organizational skills.

-Ability to multi-task competing priorities while maintaining a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
-Capable of working with cross-functional and senior stakeholders.
-Sense of accountability, good time management and ability to meet tight deadlines.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

jobs.title: Technical Business Analyst (Transfer Agency)
jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Pictet Tech division specializes in designing and integrating cutting-edge software applications, including advanced portfolio management systems, sophisticated trading platforms, and comprehensive banking and corporate solutions. As a key contributor to the Group’s strategic advancements, the division plays a vital role in driving transformative innovations that enhance our services and deliver exceptional value to our clients.

The Technical Business Analyst acts as a bridge between business stakeholders and development teams, supporting the Funds Platform with a particular focus on Transfer Agency (TA) processes. The role is responsible for understanding, analyzing, and translating business needs into effective technical solutions, ensuring the continuous improvement of business analysis practices and contributing to the overall success of the platform within the funds industry.

Your role

• Collaborate with business subject matter experts and stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements for the funds platform, with a particular focus on Transfer Agency (TA) processes and operations.

• Translate business needs into clear, actionable IT requirements, user stories, and test scenarios using Agile methodologies and Jira.

• Propose and evaluate solution options in coordination with solution architects, considering existing systems, software, and market innovations (including AI).

• Prepare and maintain comprehensive documentation, including specifications, process flows, and user guides.

• Lead project management activities as necessary, including stakeholder coordination, meeting facilitation, and milestone tracking.

• Conduct data analysis and support data-driven decision-making.

• Ensure the execution and delivery of IT projects in line with business requirements, timelines, and quality standards.

jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5000 people.

Your role

The Taiwan Intermediary sales team is currently made up of professionals who prospect and service intermediary clients throughout Taiwan by marketing Pictet Asset Management’s (Pictet AM) strategies.

Reporting to the Head of Sales - Taiwan, you will play a critical role in Pictet AM’s drive to further develop its business in Taiwan. Your responsibilities will be:

• Foster strong collaborative relationships with distributors and financial advisors to boost sales activities.

• Address and assist distributors' headquarters and clients in resolving product and market-related inquiries while nurturing relationships.

• Organize seminars and meetings to facilitate engagement and knowledge sharing.

• Actively participate in fund sales initiatives and strive to partner with distributors in campaigns to achieve the company's business goals and increase brand awareness.

• Regularly visit branches for fund promotion and training.

• Gather, organize, analyse, and share market intelligence related to distributors and industry peers.

• Contribute to the development of effective sales strategies based on market insights.

• Proactively carry out tasks assigned by the sales head, ensuring efficient and accurate completion of various assignments.

• Maintain various documents, including updating client contact information, preparing call reports, and documenting activity notes in Salesforce (SF).

Your profile

• Hold a university degree or higher, with a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in the financial industry.

• Have a deep understanding of various mutual fund products, such as equity, fixed-income, private equity and ETFs.

• Possess excellent interpersonal skills that foster effective teamwork and communication.

• Exhibit strong presentation skills to deliver persuasive sales pitches.

• Demonstrate problem-solving abilities and a strong sense of responsibility and commitment to the business.

As the successful applicant you will show drive, have a keen entrepreneurial spirit and be able to develop successful business relationships and close deals. You will also have a flair for communication, be able to manage priorities and multi-task on different projects concurrently, as well as having an eye for detail. Working in a self-reliant manner in a broader team makes you excel. You will be joining a structured and highly motivated team.

Your team

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 600 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units, and include the Communications, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Strategy & Projects, Risk and Tax departments.

In this role, you will lead and coordinate multiple sensitive and complex cross-functional Risk & Compliance projects at the Group level, steering them from strategic, operational, and organizational standpoints.

You will work in close partnership with Business Lines, Group entities, and the Group Chief Risk Officer to ensure the effective execution and successful delivery of critical initiatives.

Your responsibilities will include driving project governance, fostering collaboration across teams, and ensuring alignment with the Group’s overall objectives.

Your role

• Lead change management projects and programs, including defining roles and responsibilities, establishing project governance, ensuring the quality of deliverables, managing budgets, assessing risks, and designing new processes.
• Coordinate communication with stakeholders, organize training sessions, and ensure a thorough understanding of business needs and requirements.
• Propose and develop innovative solutions, make actionable recommendations, implement changes, and monitor project timelines and milestones.
• Prepare and present regular project updates to senior management and stakeholders.
• Contribute to the development of new solutions and define next steps for ongoing initiatives.
• Proactively challenge existing business practices, suggest improvements or new programs, and take full ownership of deliverables.
• Identify, evaluate, and implement new services and tools to enhance operational efficiency.

• Minimum of 10 years’ experience in project management, ideally within consulting and/or strategy firms. Experience in the financial or banking industry is a strong asset.
• Interest in data analytics and business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, BO), ability to work with AI, machine learning, and automation technologies.
• Proven learning agility and adaptability to thrive in a rapidly evolving technological and financial landscape.
• Highly self-motivated and autonomous, with strong conceptual thinking, an entrepreneurial mindset, and exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Full professional proficiency in both French and English, written and spoken.

jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The partner-owned financial services group provides a comprehensive offering for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

As a Direct Advisor, you will outline the view of the CIO Office and Bank’s house view to clients while providing trading support and pro-active advice. You will also answer to client queries and respond to requests for information, in compliance with the applicable procedures and internal/external rules.

Your role

• Providing private clients with close access to the market and swift access to the trading floor.
• Offering advice and responding to clients’ requests and queries.
• Advising clients with tactical investments strategies and trading ideas across all asset classes.
• Giving clients access to a selection of financial and trading publications, and translating the information gained into investment ideas.
• Keeping abreast of the latest developments on financial markets and of the macro environment.
• Interpreting financial/market reports, as well as evaluating data analysis.
• Monitoring clients’ positions with a view to optimising performance and adjusting them to take account of risk.
• Providing constant feedback to clients’ CRMs and other major stakeholders.
• Maintaining a strong compliance culture. Ensuring optimal compliance and risk management by adhering to all applicable local legislation, regulatory provisions, in-house directives and procedures as a first line of defence.
• Keeping abreast of developments in the fields so that you can apply them effectively and ensure fair treatment of all clients, while also adhering to Pictet’s mission and core values.

Your profile

• A university degree: ideally Master’s degree or a postgraduate qualification such as a CFA.
• At least 10 years’ experience in a similar function.
• A strong financial markets background with strong knowledge across asset-classes.
• Advanced knowledge of financial products and services with solid experience on derivatives.
• In-depth knowledge of the Bank’s offering.
• Fluent French and English; good knowledge of other language(s) would be a plus.
• Excellent IT skills, in particular Avaloq, Athena, Bloomberg and MS Excel.
• Strong problem-solving skills.
• A client-oriented approach.
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
• Must be resident in Switzerland, or willing to relocate.

Ref : DA/AJ/AO

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) is a leading alternative investment specialist and wholly owned subsidiary of the Pictet Group, with expertise in hedge funds, private equity and global real estate. With teams based around the world, the PAA teams construct, manage and advise on portfolios of alternative investment solutions for institutional and private clients.

You will be part of a team of 20 professionals dedicated to Pictet’s pan-European Direct Real Estate franchise, which began in 2019 with the launch of Elevation Fund I, a EUR 700 million value-add fund. Elevation Fund II was launched in 2023, and a Core Plus fund, with approximately EUR 200 million under management, was launched in 2021. The team is distributed across several locations: in London, where the core investment and asset management teams are based; in Geneva, where the investment legal and investor relations teams operate; and in Berlin, Stockholm, and Madrid, where our regional heads are located. Additionally, fund support functions such as fund administration, compliance, and legal affairs are situated in Luxembourg.

Based in Geneva or London, you will work closely with the Senior Legal Advisor covering the Direct Real Estate activity to support the activity during the maternity leave of our Legal Advisor.

Your role

• Lead the review, drafting and negotiation of a wide range of real estate and financing documents, including shareholders’ agreements, financing agreements, lease agreements, SPAs, construction agreements, etc.

• Support direct real estate transactions from inception to closing, helping to drive execution by coordinating legal workstreams, managing negotiations and liaising with internal stakeholders and external advisers.

• Act as a key legal partner on cross-border matters, working closely with internal teams across jurisdictions on transaction status, documentation, payment mechanics and related execution steps. It would be important to evidence having led transactions in at least 3 different jurisdictions.

• Provide day-to-day legal support on asset management and project matters, combining strong technical legal drafting with a practical, solutions-oriented approach to business issues. Business oriented mindset finding solutions to our team’s problems instead of acting only as a gatekeeper.
